Before we start the Daily Routine, I have a statement to make.

I'm addressing you today on a very serious matter. Province House, the precinct, and other offices are our workplaces. This is the workplace of our amazing young Pages, the dedicated commissionaires, and the committed legislative team. What happens here has an impact on them.
